title: Update a specific Flatpak app
summary: Update only one specific Flatpak application instead of all of them. Useful if you want to control which app gets updated.

steps.explain: Update a specific application by providing its application ID.

placeholders.name: APP_ID
placeholders.description: The ID of the Flatpak application to update, e.g., org.mozilla.firefox

steps.expect: The specified application is updated to the latest version.
